memoria-girl-next-door.releaseNotes: Use a globally namespaced mod ID while preserving installed settings. Update Memoria to 0.8.12 first.

memoria-meltdown.releaseNotes: Define configurable Vitality and Spirit reductions on Vit0 itself, for every source of the status. Includes localized slider descriptions.

memoria-boost-damage-limit.releaseNotes: Boost costs 200 AP and has a localized description. FFVIII summons are limited to 9,999 damage until their GF learns Boost.

russian-ffrtt.releaseNotes: Corrects speaker names, dialogue punctuation, line breaks and choice text in the FFRTT Russian translation. Memoria 0.9.13 adds native icon support for the world-map draw point prompt. Uses the existing opening movie and camera package.

russian-ffrtt-opening.releaseNotes: Adapted FFRTT opening movie and matching camera.
